items.q: Interviewer: 'Hello Rahul, is this a good time to talk?' Aap taiyar ho. Best jawab?
opts: Yes, this is a good time. Thank you for calling.

items.q: Interviewer: 'Can you tell me about yourself?' Sabse accha shuruaat?
opts: My name is Rahul, age 22, unmarried.
I am a Java developer with a year of project experience, and I recently built an expense tracker.
items.why: Present, kaam, aur ek project — seedha aur relevant.

items.q: Aapko sawaal samajh nahi aaya. Best response?
opts: Sorry, could you rephrase the question, please?

items.q: Awaaz toot rahi hai. Kya bolein?
opts: You are breaking up a little. Could you repeat the last part?
items.why: Dikkat batao aur polite request karo.

items.q: Interviewer: 'Why do you want to leave your current job?' Best jawab?
opts: My manager is bad and the pay is low.
I have learned a lot and now I am looking for bigger responsibilities and a stronger team.

items.q: Interviewer: 'What is your expected salary?' Best jawab?
opts: I am looking for something in the range of X to Y, depending on the role.

items.q: Interviewer: 'When can you join?' (notice period 30 din)
opts: My notice period is 30 days, and I can discuss an earlier date if needed.
I don't know my notice period.

items.q: Interviewer: 'Do you have any questions for us?' Best jawab?
opts: Yes, what does a typical day look like for this role?
Can I leave early on Fridays?
items.why: Role ke baare mein ek achha sawaal.

items.q: Aapko jawab nahi pata. Best response?
opts: I have not worked with that directly, but I understand the idea and I can learn it quickly.

items.q: Interviewer: 'Tell me about a time you handled pressure.' Pehla kadam?
opts: Start with the Situation: where, when, what happened.

items.q: Call kat gayi aur aapne wapas judkar kya kaha?
opts: Sorry about that, my connection dropped. Where were we?

items.q: Aapko sochne ka time chahiye. Kya bolein?
opts: Let me think about that for a moment.
items.why: Ye phrase 5 second ka time deta hai.

items.q: Interviewer: 'Why should we hire you?' Best structure?
opts: My skills match your needs, I learn fast, and I have built relevant projects.
Because I am the best in the world.

items.q: Call ke end mein sabse acha closing?
opts: Thank you for your time. I am very interested in this role. What are the next steps?

items.q: Interviewer ne English bahut tez boli. Kya bolein?
opts: Could you speak a little slower, please?

items.q: Aap apna role batana chahte ho. Kaun sa sentence behtar?
opts: I wrote the API and my teammate designed the screens.
items.why: 'I' se apna role saaf hota hai.

items.q: Video call mein koi aapko screen share karne ko kehta hai. Kya bolein?
opts: Sure, let me share my screen. Can you see it?
